name: Smoke + GS History+Wave: marbled (artefact)
description: Gentle stirring (stir 0.2) with no smoothing, and the wave feeding the smoke (wave_to_smoke 0.05): the history marbles into big swirling bands. The bands come from the stirring's ripples (with stir_smooth 1 they go, and so does the chemistry), but they're gorgeous.
